project.title: I'm Only Eating for You
project.logline: One breakfast, my mother and I tease my father until he leaves the table; a smile and a 'sorry' bring him back, with a line our family still laughs about.
project.audience: My family and our relatives in Ethiopia and abroad, watching on their phones in the family group chat and on my social media.
project.intent: They should laugh at a moment they recognise, remember our father with love, and leave feeling that in our family a simple 'sorry' is enough to bring someone back to the table.

narration.style_instruction: Warm, gently amused storyteller remembering a family moment, unhurried, natural Amharic

shots.beat: Where we are: a family breakfast.
shots.reason: Establishes the home, the morning and the three of us together before anything goes wrong.

keyframe.prompt: wide shot of a family of three sitting around the breakfast table, the father at the head of the table in the centre, the mother on the left, the young man on the right, steam rising from tea glasses

motion.prompt: steam rises gently from the tea glasses, the family sits calmly and smiles softly, faces stay steady, static camera

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: በቤታችን ቁርስ ሁላችንም አብረን የምንሆንበት ጊዜ ነበር።
lines.subtitle_en: In our house, breakfast was the time we were all together.

shots.reason: Shows mom and me as a team, laughing, so the audience is in on the joke before it goes too far.

keyframe.prompt: medium shot, the mother and the young man lean toward each other at the breakfast table, laughing and whispering mischievously, centred in frame

motion.prompt: they smile and their shoulders shake gently with quiet laughter, faces stay steady, static camera

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: አንድ ቀን ጠዋት እኔና እናቴ አባቴ የማይወዳቸውን ነገሮች እያነሳን መቀለድ ጀመርን።
lines.subtitle_en: One morning, my mom and I started joking about the things my dad doesn't like.

shots.reason: The turn of the story: a close-up of his face tells the audience the joke has landed badly.

keyframe.prompt: close-up of the father at the breakfast table, frowning, annoyed, holding a piece of bread, centred

motion.prompt: he slowly puts down the bread and frowns, camera pushes in slightly

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: እኛ አስቂኝ መስሎን ነበር። እሱ ግን አልሳቀም።
lines.subtitle_en: We thought it was funny. He didn't laugh.

shots.reason: The half-eaten plate is the image of what our joke cost him, and it sets up the ending.

keyframe.prompt: close insert of a half-eaten plate of firfir and a glass of tea in front of an empty chair pushed back from the table

motion.prompt: steam fades slowly from the tea glass, the room is still, fixed camera

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle_en: Upset, he got up and left the table before finishing his breakfast.

shots.beat: A quiet pause: he washes his hands.
shots.reason: A slow, silent-feeling moment that lets the tension sit before he returns.

keyframe.prompt: close insert of the father's hands being washed over a metal basin, water pouring from a metal jug, blue shirt cuffs visible

motion.prompt: water pours slowly over his hands into the basin, fixed camera

shots.beat: He comes back and just stands there.
shots.reason: His silent return is the emotional centre: he wants to come back but is waiting for something.

keyframe.prompt: medium shot of the father standing quietly in the dining room doorway, hands by his sides, looking at the table with a sad face, centred

motion.prompt: he stands still in the doorway, the lace curtain moves slightly, faces stay steady, static camera

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: ከዚያም ተመልሶ መጣና ምንም ሳይናገር ዝም ብሎ ቆመ።
lines.subtitle_en: Then he came back and stood there quietly, without a word.

shots.beat: We realise, smile and say sorry.
shots.reason: The turning point of the story: the apology, shown on our faces.

keyframe.prompt: medium close-up, the mother and the young man at the table look up toward the doorway with gentle apologetic smiles, centred

motion.prompt: they look up and smile softly, the mother nods gently, fixed camera

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: ያኔ እንዳሳዘንነው ገባን። ፈገግ ብለን ይቅርታ ጠየቅነው።
lines.subtitle_en: Then we realised we had made him sad. We smiled and said sorry.

shots.beat: He laughs, sits down and delivers the line.
shots.reason: The punchline, in Dad's own voice, is the moment the whole film builds toward.

keyframe.prompt: medium shot of the father sitting back down at the breakfast table, laughing warmly, picking up bread again, centred

motion.prompt: he smiles warmly and slowly lifts a piece of bread, small natural movement, faces stay steady, static camera

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: ሳቀ፣ ተመልሶ ተቀመጠና መብላት ጀመረ። ከዚያም እንዲህ አለ፦
lines.subtitle_en: He laughed, sat back down and started eating. Then he said:

lines.speaker: dad
lines.text: ተመልሼ የመጣሁት ይቅርታ ስላላችሁኝ ነው። የምበላው ለእናንተ ብዬ ብቻ ነው!
lines.subtitle_en: "I only came back because you said sorry. I'm only eating for you!"
lines.style: a father pretending to be serious but clearly amused, playful and warm

shots.beat: Today: the line became a family joke.
shots.reason: Brings the story to the audience's own table and states what it means to us now.

keyframe.prompt: wide shot of the family of three laughing together around the breakfast table, the father in the centre, warm golden light

motion.prompt: the family smiles together, steam rises from the tea, faces stay steady, static camera

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: ዛሬም ድረስ ይህን ስናስታውስ እንስቃለን። አንዳንዴ አንድ ይቅርታ ሰውን ወደ ማዕድ ይመልሳል።
lines.subtitle_en: To this day, we laugh when we remember it. Sometimes one 'sorry' is enough to bring someone back to the table.

end_card.subtext: In loving memory of our dad, Abbaye. Pictures, voices and music made with AI from our family's story.
